thread:
sanjay patel: Heads-up — we're seeing an auth-noise spike across eu-west-1. Multiple tenants (~3) report simultaneous failed MFA pushes and a bunch of 401s. Alert threshold kicked in at 12:04 UTC. Anyone on call?

natalie chu: I see the alerts. Ticket volume up in support, users complaining push never appears.

alex taylor: grabbing logs now. Curious if this is APNs/FCM or our push-sender path.

infra-bot: Alert: auth.service.auth_fail_rate > 12/min for tenant:acme, tenant:veridian, tenant:ora (duration: 5m). Recent change: rbac-token-cache rollout at 11:50 UTC.

maria kim: @sanjay could this be related to the RBAC token caching change? We added a refresh optimization that touches KMS access patterns.

jordan li: I pulled the push queue metrics — push-queue-delay spiked concurrently. provider-errors show increased 5xx from fcm endpoints for ~3m. Could be provider-side but MFA push fails don't match 401s.

alex taylor: logs snippet: 
```
[2025-11-19T12:03:59Z] auth.gateway: jwt verify failed: kms:Decrypt failed: [ErrCode:KMS-403] decrypt timeout
[2025-11-19T12:04:00Z] auth.mfa: push_send failed tenant=acme provider=fcm err=provider-500
```

natalie chu: KMS decrypt errors make me nervous. Which key? service-account key for token signing?

sanjay patel: Looks like the RBAC change touched token refresh flow which uses the signing key via KMS. Could be transient KMS latency causing token verify failures and then falling back to push flows that error.

maria kim: Action proposal: 1) Temporarily pause the new rbac-token-cache rollout (rollback canary). 2) Pause automated push retries for affected tenants to reduce MFA fatigue. 3) Open SOC investigation and mark as P2 until root cause confirmed. Thoughts?

jordan li: +1 on pausing retries. We can also increase cache TTL to avoid hitting KMS for each refresh while we triage.

infra-bot: Runbook suggestion: `rbac-canary-rollback.sh --env=prod --components=auth-token-cache`

alex taylor: Executed rollback of rbac-token-cache canary on eu-west-1 at 12:09 UTC. Rolling back to stable-3. Verified KMS decrypt errors drop in logs but we still see provider 500s.

natalie chu: Verified support ticket updates: asked affected tenants to expect reduced MFA prompts while we stabilize. Created incident in PagerDuty and labeled as "auth-noise - tenant throttle".

incident-bot: Incident created: INC-20251119-231. Severity: P2. Assigned: natalie chu, alex taylor.

maria kim: We should also capture audit logs for all admin RBAC changes in the 11:30-12:10 window and export to S3 for SOC. If KMS errors are involved, include KMS CloudTrail entries.

sanjay patel: Agreed. @alex can you pull auth gateway traces and KMS request IDs so infra can correlate with KMS account? Add relevant trace IDs to the incident.

alex taylor: Pushed logs to incident S3 bucket: s3://redwood-incident-logs/INC-20251119-231/auth-gateway/ and included KMS request IDs. Also bumped push provider circuit-breaker to short-circuit providers returning repeated 5xx for 1m to reduce retry storm.

jordan li: Noted a secondary effect: user accounts got short-lived lock states due to consecutive verify failures; support is manually unlocking a few. We should add an automated grace for 5xx provider errors to avoid lockouts.

natalie chu: For communications: drafting a support banner template and tenant emails explaining transient MFA interruptions and we've told them no suspicious logins detected — likely infrastructure issue.

maria kim: Post-incident actions I'm going to own: 1) Add KMS latency monitoring with alerting; 2) Add RBAC rollout checklist to include KMS smoke tests; 3) Update MFA retry/backoff runbook.

sanjay patel: Alex/natalie, please run a short postmortem: timeline, root cause (if confirmed KMS or provider), mitigations, and preventive controls. Target: draft within 48h. Also, tag any RBAC change owners for follow-up.

alex taylor: Will do. Early RCA: cascade where RBAC canary increased KMS calls -> transient KMS decrypt failures -> token verify fails -> fallback flows triggered -> increased push retries -> provider 5xx & user lock states. Still validating exact KMS SLAs.

jordan li: I'll add a metric for "auth.fallback_rate" to the dashboard and create an alert for >5/min sustained across tenants.

natalie chu: Assigning follow-ups in the incident board. Setting next update in 30m. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

sanjay patel: Thanks everyone. Keep comms tight. We'll follow up with a more detailed postmortem once we confirm KMS telemetry.
